title: The red shopfront dance: a straight face, a stiff little groove, you and your dog
summary: Turn a photo of you, or you and your dog, into a deadpan dance clip on the pavement outside a bright red shopfront. The straight face is the joke.
why: A trend roundup from Getstarrd's November 2026 list says a deadpan lobby dance in front of a red shopfront passed 670,000 plays on TikTok in mid-November, and that AI versions with a dog followed. We found it on that one roundup, so treat it as a fresh, small trend.
steps: Pick a clear, full-body photo of you standing up. For the dog version, use one photo with you and your dog together.
Upload it to an image-to-video tool and paste the main prompt. Change the bracketed parts.
Make two or three versions and keep the one where your face stays the same and the moves stay stiff and small.
Add a short, dry caption and a trending sound in your app. Say it was made with AI.

prompts.label: Main prompt: solo deadpan dance
prompts.text: Animate this photo of me. I stand on a city pavement in front of a glossy red shopfront with big glass windows and warm light inside. Keeping my face, hair and clothes exactly the same, I do a small, stiff dance with a totally straight face: a little side step, a shoulder pop, a slow arm wave, then I stop and stare at the camera. The camera stays still at chest height. Daylight, real-phone look, 8 seconds.

prompts.label: Variation: you and your dog
prompts.text: Animate this photo of me and my dog on a city pavement in front of a bright red shopfront. Keep both of us looking exactly like the photo. I do a stiff, serious little dance: side step, side step, shoulder pop. My dog sits beside me, then stands up on its back legs for a moment and copies the shoulder pop before sitting back down. Neither of us smiles. Still camera, daylight, 8 seconds.

prompts.label: Variation: the office crew
prompts.text: Animate this photo of three co-workers (all agreed) standing in a row in front of a red shopfront. Keep everyone's face and outfit the same. With straight faces, they do the same tiny dance in sync: side step, clap once, slow point at the camera. One person is half a beat late every time. Still camera, natural daylight, 8 seconds.

prompts.label: Variation for a small business: outside your own shop
prompts.text: Animate this photo of me standing outside my own [café / boutique / salon] front door. Keep my face, outfit, the shop front and the sign exactly as they are. With a perfectly straight face, I do a stiff little dance: side step, shoulder pop, then point at the open door and walk inside. Still camera, daylight, 8 seconds.

tips: Ask for small, stiff moves. Big moves make AI faces and hands wobble.
The straight face is the whole joke. Add 'no smiling' if your first try grins.
Use your own shop or a made-up one. Don't show another business's real sign or logo.
Dogs look most natural when they mostly sit and do just one quick move.
